'''2000 California State Championship''' was a Star Wars CCG state championship held in California in spring 2000. [[Clayton Atkin]] won it; he posted his Dark deck as "the CCT Skrilling deck that I used to help me WIN the California State Championship", beating Mind What You Have Learned, Profit and an Obi-Wan's Hut deck in the final.<ref name="dt-7228">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/7228 Atkins Skrillings], DeckTech (Clayton "TheDohMan" Atkin, 28 May 2000). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/7228/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/7228/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Dates:''' 2000 (before 28 May)
* '''Site:''' California
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Clayton Atkin]]
